register.requirement: Employers with 20+ jobs must fill 5% with severely disabled people; by 31 March file the prior-year report with the Agentur für Arbeit (REHADAT-Elan) and pay the levy to the Integrationsamt (for 2025: EUR 155/275/405 per unfilled place per month by quota band, EUR 815 at zero). Keep a register of severely disabled employees.

register.name: Germany Schwerbehindertenvertretung & inclusion agreement
register.requirement: Where 5+ severely disabled employees work, an SBV is elected; it must be informed and heard before decisions affecting them (a dismissal without SBV hearing is void) and may attend interviews of disabled applicants. Conclude an Inklusionsvereinbarung with the SBV and works council.

register.name: Germany BEM (occupational reintegration management)
register.requirement: Offer BEM in writing, with data-protection information, to every employee absent more than 6 weeks (continuous or cumulative) in 12 months, involving the works council and SBV with consent; a sickness dismissal without a proper BEM offer usually fails.

register.name: Germany working-time recording & ArbZG limits
register.requirement: Record start, end and duration of daily working time for all employees except executives (BAG 13 Sep 2022), keep time beyond 8 h/day for 2 years, and monitor the 10-hour day, 11-hour rest and Sunday ban. A 2026 draft would require same-day electronic recording.

register.name: Germany leave forfeiture notices
register.requirement: Tell each employee individually and in good time how much leave remains, ask them to take it and warn that it will lapse at year-end or on 31 March; without notice statutory leave never lapses or becomes time-barred and must be paid out at exit.

register.name: Germany social insurance registration & contributions
register.requirement: Register each employee with the health insurer via DEÜV (with the first payroll, within 6 weeks), pay contributions by the third-last banking day each month, file annual DEÜV reports by 15 Feb and deregister within 6 weeks of exit; 2026 ceilings EUR 8,450 (pension/unemployment) and EUR 5,812.50 (health/care) per month.
register.cadence: Monthly; annual (15 Feb); per hire and exit

register.name: Germany wage-tax filings
register.requirement: File the Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung and pay wage tax, solidarity surcharge and church tax by the 10th of the following month, transmit electronic Lohnsteuerbescheinigungen by the last day of February, and run the annual equalisation for eligible employees at 10+ employees.

register.name: Germany occupational safety organisation & risk assessment
register.requirement: Keep documented risk assessments (including psychological stress and MuSchG workplace assessments), a company doctor and safety specialist, a quarterly safety committee at more than 20 employees, safety officers, first aiders and fire-safety assistants, and give safety instruction before starting work and annually.
register.cadence: Quarterly committee; annual instruction; review on change
register.cite: ArbSchG §§5, 12; ASiG §§2, 5, 11; SGB VII §22; MuSchG §10; DGUV Vorschrift 1-2

register.name: Germany accident reporting & Berufsgenossenschaft annual report
register.requirement: Report work and commuting accidents causing death or more than 3 days' incapacity to the Berufsgenossenschaft within 3 days, keep first-aid logs 5 years, and file the digital annual payroll report by 16 February.

register.name: Germany maternity protection notification & assessment
register.requirement: On learning of a pregnancy, notify the supervisory authority without delay, update the individual risk assessment and offer a discussion of adjustments; observe protection periods (including miscarriage protection from week 13 since June 2025) and the dismissal ban.

register.name: Germany DPO, processing records & DPIAs
register.requirement: Appoint a data protection officer where 20+ persons regularly process personal data automatically and notify the BayLDA or Saxon DPA; keep Art. 30 records, run DPIAs before monitoring, people analytics or AI tools, and report breaches within 72 hours.

register.name: EU AI Act HR controls (Germany)
register.requirement: No emotion recognition at work (since 2 Feb 2025); support AI literacy (Art. 4); by 2 Dec 2027 deployers of Annex III employment tools must ensure human oversight, keep logs, follow instructions and inform the works council and affected workers before use. The Bundesnetzagentur supervises under the KI-MIG.
register.cite: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 Arts. 4, 5, 26, Annex III(4); Regulation (EU) 2026/1744; KI-MIG

register.name: Germany employee invention (ArbnErfG) process
register.requirement: Receive text-form invention disclosures, confirm receipt, claim or release within 4 months (claim is otherwise deemed), file German patent applications for claimed service inventions and pay statutory compensation, which cannot be waived in advance.
